description: A vertical list of rows (links, or buttons that select in place), one marked current. Rows hold rich content; hover fills with surface.hover; the current row holds the deeper surface.selected. Tagged here rather than in the file block because NavListItem shares this module and maps to its own Figma set through figma/mapping-overrides.json.

usage.when: List sibling destinations as rows that can hold a title, a meta line and a badge, with the open one marked current (a rail of jobs, documents or records).
usage.whenNot: Switching views inside one page, or a trail back up a hierarchy.

useInstead.reason: switching between views on the same page
showing where the current page sits in a hierarchy
a list of actions rather than destinations
